verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an agent-first sandbox path: coding agents run `stripe sandbox create` to provision an anonymous Stripe sandbox with working API keys and no account registration, which keeps testing off production data. MPP adds `mppx validate` for end-to-end conformance testing of discovery, challenges, errors and the payment flow. missing for 10: explicit documentation that ACS checkout, SPT and Link CLI flows run inside sandboxes; description of sandbox data isolation and limits; independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.
